Các số liệu công suất phòng Đà Nẵng trên: The Da Nang hotel occupancy figures in the press mostly come from hotels that have operated for many years, with room sales systems, group bookings and contracts with travel agencies. A newly launched individually rented apartment usually has no reviews on booking channels yet, so its first-year occupancy may be lower than the market level. When building a spreadsheet, Hoang Hiep usually takes the market figure minus a safety margin for the first year, then raises it gradually as the unit earns good reviews.
